name: create_vault_folder
description:
Creates an empty folder in a vault at path, with any missing folders above it, like mkdir -p. A folder already at path is reported and left as it is. Folders stay until they are deleted, even when empty.

Search keywords: create vault folder, new vault folder, vault mkdir.

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces. Must satisfy the required format.

path.description: The folder's path, such as "/Reports/Q3". Must satisfy the required format.
